trial.question: Is the free trial really no-commitment?
trial.answer: Yes, you can test our CRM for 14 days without a credit card. At the end of the trial, you decide whether to continue or not.

upgrade.question: Can I change my plan at any time?
upgrade.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade whenever you want. Billing will be adjusted pro-rata.

data.question: What happens to my data if I cancel?
data.answer: Your data remains accessible for 30 days after cancellation. You can export it at any time.

support.question: What support is included?
support.answer: All plans include email support. Pro and higher plans get priority support with guaranteed response times.
